question: Six friends, P, Q, R, S, T and U, are sitting around a circular table at equal distance between each other, facing the centre. S is sitting between U and Q. P is second to the left of S and second to the right of T. Q is sitting between T and S. Who is sitting opposite to S?
solution:
According to the question:
